name: Young Scholars Program (YSP)
what_you_do: Do hands-on research with Northeastern faculty. Fields are engineering, science and health sciences. You take a seminar series. It is called Introduction to Engineering. You get college and career advice. You visit company and government sites.
grades: Entering 12th grade in the fall (current juniors)
who_can_apply: Current juniors. You must be a permanent Massachusetts resident. That means you live and go to school in MA all year. You must live within commuting distance of campus. You must be a US citizen or permanent resident, with no exceptions.
pay_detail: Free program. No stipend is mentioned on the page.
duration: About six weeks. 2027 dates: June 22 to July 31, 2027, Monday to Thursday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., in person on the Northeastern campus.
deadline_text: Applications open Dec 14, 2026 and close March 1, 2027 at 5 p.m. Teacher recommendations are due March 8 or 9 (the page lists both dates).
how_to_apply: Fill out the Online Student Application. It takes 60 to 90 minutes. You cannot save it or restart it. So write the essay answers ahead of time. You also need two teacher recommendations. A STEM teacher is best. Enter the recommenders' email addresses in the application.
notes: Free, but only for Massachusetts residents who are US citizens or permanent residents. Late applications are not accepted. Read the program FAQ before emailing the coordinator. The same page also has a line saying applications are due March 2nd, 2026, which conflicts with the March 1, 2027 close date. Confirm the 2027 date with the program before you plan around it.
